notablePrerequisites: You do not control another Spirit or have a Spirit in your graveyard.
description:
Cast Kiri-Onna by paying {4}{U}.
Volo triggers, creating a copy of the Kiri-Onna spell.
The Kiri-Onna copy enters, triggering itself.
Holding priority, activate Food Chain by exiling the Kiri-Onna token, adding {U}{U}{U}{U}{U}{U} that can only be spent on creature spells.
Kiri-Onna enters the battlefield, returning itself to your hand.
Repeat.
